faqs.question: How can EMI shielding and thermal management be balanced in one enclosure?
faqs.answer: Start with the heat load, airflow path, allowable openings, shielding objectives and maintenance constraints. SONNE can review conductive paths, joints, covers, vents and compartment layouts as related design choices. The appropriate balance and required verification depend on the equipment specification; neither EMI nor thermal performance should be assumed from enclosure material alone.

faqs.question: Is a 3D model enough for an enclosure quotation or design review?
faqs.answer: A 3D model is useful for evaluating geometry, space and interfaces, but it usually does not define all acceptance requirements. Also provide available 2D drawings, materials, finishes, critical dimensions, GD&T, fasteners, quantities and application conditions. If information is missing, SONNE can identify open items before defining the next review or quotation step.

faqs.question: Can SONNE provide IP55 or IP65 telecom cabinets?
faqs.answer: IP55 and IP65 are within the enclosure capability information provided for project evaluation. The achievable rating depends on the complete cabinet design, seals, joints, cable entries and agreed verification method. Share the installation environment and target rating so the requirements can be reviewed; do not treat a capability statement as certification for every custom enclosure.

faqs.question: What information is needed for a custom CNC heatsink review?
faqs.answer: Provide the heat source and dissipation target, available envelope, mounting interface, airflow conditions, material preference, surface requirements, critical tolerances and production stage. Include 2D and 3D files when available. These inputs allow the machining and thermal interfaces to be reviewed together; final geometry and verification requirements remain project-specific.

faqs.question: How are enclosure design changes controlled after sample approval?
faqs.answer: Changes should be linked to the controlled drawing and BOM revision, with the reason, affected parts and review result recorded. Depending on the change, the review may cover fit, machining, finish, shielding, thermal interfaces and renewed verification. Customer notification or approval points, inventory disposition and the effective production stage should be agreed for the specific project.

faqs.answer: Factory audit and visit requests can be reviewed around a specific project. The agenda may cover relevant machining, assembly, testing, traceability and change-control records. faqs.question: What RF testing capabilities are available?
faqs.answer: SONNE's stated capabilities include VNA, PIM, reliability and multi-port matrix automated testing. Buyers should identify critical RF parameters and acceptance criteria during engineering review so the verification plan and evidence requirements can be defined.

faqs.question: What inputs are needed to start an engineering review?
faqs.answer: Provide the application, project stage and the information already available: frequency or band plan, RF targets, power or PIM needs, mechanical envelope, connectors, drawings, environment and quantity range. Unknown items can be marked as open. SONNE can then identify missing inputs, review feasibility questions and recommend the next design, prototype or testing step.

faqs.question: What should an engineering review deliver before prototyping?
faqs.answer: A useful review should leave a controlled record of known requirements, open questions, assumptions, major mechanical or RF risks and the proposed verification scope. Depending on the project, it may also include drawing or DFM comments and a prototype input baseline. It should not be presented as a performance guarantee before hardware has been tested.

faqs.question: Does annual capacity guarantee a production lead time?
faqs.answer: No. SONNE states annual capacity above 500,000 units and more than 50 high-precision CNC machines, but those figures do not determine a specific delivery date. Prototype and mass-production schedules should therefore be confirmed separately for each project.

faqs.question: What parameters are needed for a custom RF design evaluation?
faqs.answer: Provide the frequency range or band plan, bandwidth, ports and impedance, insertion loss, return loss, rejection or isolation targets, power and PIM where applicable. Add connector or flange details, mechanical envelope, environment, drawings and project stage. Include test conditions with critical targets; unknown items can be listed as open for review.

faqs.question: Can SONNE participate in design evaluation instead of only machining to drawing?
faqs.answer: Yes, engineering evaluation is part of the stated custom RF design capability for filter, waveguide and combiner projects. The review can connect RF requirements with mechanical and manufacturing constraints, identify open questions and define prototype verification. The exact scope depends on the supplied information and agreed project objectives, and remains subject to hardware validation.

faqs.question: What frequency range can a custom RF project cover?
faqs.answer: SONNE's standard product portfolio is centered on production from DC to 40 GHz. Selected custom microwave and waveguide projects can reach 110 GHz, depending on topology and verification. Frequency alone is not enough to confirm feasibility; the design review must also consider interfaces, performance targets, mechanical structure, manufacturing constraints and the applicable test method.
faqs.intent: 核实定制项目频率边界并避免过度承诺

faqs.question: What outputs should I expect from an RF engineering review?
faqs.answer: Expected review outputs can include a requirement and open-item list, documented assumptions, RF and mechanical risks, design or DFM comments, and a proposed prototype verification matrix. The agreed output set should be confirmed for the project. Simulation or design analysis should be identified separately from measured hardware evidence, so your team can see what remains to be validated.

faqs.question: How quickly can SONNE provide initial engineering feedback?
faqs.answer: A complete RFQ can typically receive initial engineering feedback in about 24 hours. faqs.question: What still needs verification after a prototype passes?
faqs.answer: Prototype approval does not by itself demonstrate production repeatability. The next review should confirm controlled drawings and BOM, first article requirements, manufacturing and assembly risks, test settings, coverage, traceability and open deviations. A pilot run can then evaluate whether the proposed process and evidence baseline support the agreed production-release criteria.
faqs.intent: 理解样品通过与量产准备之间的差距
faqs.snippet: 目标为 45–60 词，先否定直接等同，再列出后续验证项

faqs.question: How are engineering changes traced during NPI and production?
faqs.answer: An engineering change should reference the affected drawing and BOM revisions, reason, parts and production stage. The review records potential RF, mechanical, process and test impacts, plus any required re-verification. Effectivity, inventory or work-in-progress disposition, and customer notification or approval points should be agreed and linked to the project record.
faqs.intent: 审查 ECN 版本和变更影响是否可追溯
faqs.snippet: 目标为 45–60 词的流程型答案，覆盖变更、影响、验证和生效点

faqs.question: What is the difference between FAI and a golden sample?
faqs.answer: First article inspection documents whether specified characteristics of the first article meet the controlled requirements, including applicable measurements and deviations. A golden sample is an approved physical reference linked to a product and revision. It can support comparison, but it does not replace the inspection records, test data or acceptance decisions required for the project.
faqs.intent: 澄清首件检验与批准参考样品的不同证据作用
faqs.snippet: 目标为 45–55 词的定义对比，适合段落 Featured Snippet

faqs.question: What should be reviewed before a pilot run is released to production?
faqs.answer: Review the agreed drawing and BOM baseline, first article status, pilot results, critical process and assembly settings, test limits and coverage, traceability, and unresolved deviations. Each open item needs a documented disposition and a decision on whether it blocks release. The exact exit criteria and required customer approvals should be defined in the NPI plan.
faqs.intent: 建立试产转量产的审查清单
faqs.snippet: 目标为 45–60 词，按放行证据和开放项处置组织

faqs.question: How long do RF prototyping and NPI take?
faqs.answer: There is no universal NPI schedule. The fastest prototype reference is about two weeks, but it is not a general lead-time promise. Actual timing depends on design freeze, geometry, materials, finishing, quantity, test scope, deviation cycles and capacity. Mass-production delivery must be assessed separately from prototype and stage-gate timing.

faqs.snippet: 目标为 45–55 词，保留最快参考并明确非通用承诺

faqs.question: How should I read a PIM test report?
faqs.answer: Read the PIM result together with the product identity, frequency or band, test power, port and connection configuration, measurement units, limit and test conditions. Check whether the reported result corresponds to the required sample or lot and acceptance criterion. A single dBc value without those conditions is not enough for a meaningful comparison or approval decision.
faqs.intent: 读懂 PIM 报告并避免脱离条件比较数值
faqs.snippet: 目标为 50–60 词，按标识、条件、限值和批次顺序解答

faqs.question: What is SONNE's RF test coverage?
faqs.answer: Test coverage is defined by the product, critical characteristics, agreed specification and production stage. SONNE identifies critical RF testing and can apply 100% verification only where the specific product and measurement requirement support that statement. It should not be interpreted as 100% coverage of every test on every product. Confirm the coverage matrix during project review.
faqs.intent: 核实 100% 测试表述的实际范围
faqs.snippet: 目标为 50–60 词，明确按产品和指标定义并否定全产品泛化

faqs.question: What information should a VNA test report include?
faqs.answer: A useful VNA report should identify the product and revision, relevant lot or serial information where applicable, ports, frequency range, measured S-parameters, test settings and applicable calibration status. It should also show limits, units, curves or numerical results and the acceptance decision. The exact report content and supplied data format should be agreed for the project.
faqs.intent: 审查 VNA 报告是否具备验收所需上下文
faqs.snippet: 目标为 50–60 词的字段清单型 Featured Snippet

faqs.question: How are RF test results traced to production records?
faqs.answer: Traceability should link the test record to the product or project, applicable lot or serial identifier, drawing or BOM revision, production and test stage, and any deviation disposition. The required depth depends on the product and agreed control plan. During supplier review, buyers can request evidence showing those links rather than relying on an isolated curve or summary value.
faqs.intent: 判断测试结果能否回溯到具体产品和生产版本
faqs.snippet: 目标为 45–60 词，列出追溯链并提出审核证据

faqs.question: Can I request a sample RF test report before placing an order?
faqs.answer: You can request a sample test report to review the evidence format and discuss the fields needed for your project. Identify the product type and test method, such as VNA or PIM, so the request can be directed appropriately. A sample is illustrative only; actual measurements, coverage, traceability and report deliverables must be confirmed for your product and specification.

faqs.snippet: 目标为 45–60 词，直接肯定申请路径并说明样例非项目结果
